none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization on ℝ^d. A minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R. No strong convexity or convexity of individual sample maps is required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One call queries (x,y) and returns (g(x,ξ),g(y,ξ)) using the same sample. Samples are fresh IID across calls, and E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Each budget unit counts one paired call, containing two gradient evaluations. All Params are public; f, g and the sampling distribution are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible and publicInput; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace; LongTails/Setups/EuclideanStrongGrowthMeanSquared.lean: spec.Public and publicInput.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: Unbiased multiplicative noise satisfies E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤Γ²‖∇f(x)‖² for every x. This is an integrated second-moment condition, without a pointwise relative-error or exponential-tail bound.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The space is Euclidean ℝ^d. Public parameters satisfy Lbar>0, Γ≥0, R>0, ε>0, 67108864√(1+Γ²)ε≤Lbar R², and d≥(Lbar R²/(√(1+Γ²)ε))³. The sample space contains two distinct points with measurable singletons.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Mean-squared smoothness holds under the same sample: E‖g(x,ξ)−g(y,ξ)‖²≤Lbar²‖x−y‖². The oracle is jointly measurable and all stated first and second moments are integrable. Individual sample maps need not be gradients or individually Lipschitz.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StrongGrowthMeanSquaredSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, measurability, integrability and gradient-difference conjuncts.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point X∈ℝ^d with integrable objective gap and E[f(X)−f(x⋆)]≤ε for a global minimizer x⋆. No particular iterate or averaging rule is prescribed.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee averages over the algorithm's private randomness and the IID oracle sequence, within a fixed oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: A structured stochastic convex formulation combining multiplicative second-moment noise, mean-squared smoothness, same-sample paired queries, and explicit dimension–accuracy restrictions.
